summary.headline: HPSP to buy back KRW 100bn of its own shares, through Feb 24, 2027
summary.what_happened: On Nov 24, 2026, HPSP's board resolved to acquire up to 2,688,172 common shares for an expected total of KRW 100bn, on the KOSDAQ market through direct on-exchange purchases via NH Investment & Securities, over the period Nov 25, 2026 to Feb 24, 2027. The company states the purpose is share price stabilization and shareholder value enhancement, and that acquired shares are, in principle, to be cancelled.
summary.why_it_matters: Share buybacks in Korea are typically announced to support the share price or return value to shareholders, and when acquired shares are cancelled they reduce the total number of shares outstanding. Actual quantities and amounts depend on market prices and may differ from the planned figures.
